p.src: 1  “When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.

en: “When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
u.src: 1  “When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.

p.src: 2  They called to them, so they went from them. They sacrificed to the Baals, and burned incense to engraved images.

en: They called to them, so they went from them. They sacrificed to the Baals, and burned incense to engraved images.
u.src: 2  They called to them, so they went from them. They sacrificed to the Baals, and burned incense to engraved images.

p.src: 3  Yet I taught Ephraim to walk. I took them by their arms, but they didn’t know that I healed them.

en: Yet I taught Ephraim to walk. I took them by their arms, but they didn’t know that I healed them.
u.src: 3  Yet I taught Ephraim to walk. I took them by their arms, but they didn’t know that I healed them.

p.src: 4  I drew them with cords of a man, with ties of love; and I was to them like those who lift up the yoke on their necks; and I bent down to him and I fed him.

en: I drew them with cords of a man, with ties of love; and I was to them like those who lift up the yoke on their necks; and I bent down to him and I fed him.
u.src: 4  I drew them with cords of a man, with ties of love; and I was to them like those who lift up the yoke on their necks; and I bent down to him and I fed him.

p.src: 5  “They won’t return into the land of Egypt; but the Assyrian will be their king, because they refused to repent.

en: “They won’t return into the land of Egypt; but the Assyrian will be their king, because they refused to repent.
u.src: 5  “They won’t return into the land of Egypt; but the Assyrian will be their king, because they refused to repent.

p.src: 6  The sword will fall on their cities, and will destroy the bars of their gates, and will put an end to their plans.

en: The sword will fall on their cities, and will destroy the bars of their gates, and will put an end to their plans.
u.src: 6  The sword will fall on their cities, and will destroy the bars of their gates, and will put an end to their plans.

p.src: 7  My people are determined to turn from me. Though they call to the Most High, he certainly won’t exalt them.

en: My people are determined to turn from me. Though they call to the Most High, he certainly won’t exalt them.
u.src: 7  My people are determined to turn from me. Though they call to the Most High, he certainly won’t exalt them.

p.src: 8  “How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned within me, my compassion is aroused.

en: “How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned within me, my compassion is aroused.
u.src: 8  “How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned within me, my compassion is aroused.

p.src: 9  I will not execute the fierceness of my anger. I will not return to destroy Ephraim, for I am God, and not man—the Holy One among you. I will not come in wrath.

en: I will not execute the fierceness of my anger. I will not return to destroy Ephraim, for I am God, and not man—the Holy One among you. I will not come in wrath.
u.src: 9  I will not execute the fierceness of my anger. I will not return to destroy Ephraim, for I am God, and not man—the Holy One among you. I will not come in wrath.

p.src: 10  They will walk after the LORD, who will roar like a lion; for he will roar, and the children will come trembling from the west.

en: They will walk after the LORD, who will roar like a lion; for he will roar, and the children will come trembling from the west.
u.src: 10  They will walk after the LORD, who will roar like a lion; for he will roar, and the children will come trembling from the west.

p.src: 11  They will come trembling like a bird out of Egypt, and like a dove out of the land of Assyria; and I will settle them in their houses,” says the LORD.

en: They will come trembling like a bird out of Egypt, and like a dove out of the land of Assyria; and I will settle them in their houses,” says the LORD.
u.src: 11  They will come trembling like a bird out of Egypt, and like a dove out of the land of Assyria; and I will settle them in their houses,” says the LORD.

p.src: 12  Ephraim surrounds me with falsehood, and the house of Israel with deceit. Judah still strays from God, and is unfaithful to the Holy One.

en: Ephraim surrounds me with falsehood, and the house of Israel with deceit. Judah still strays from God, and is unfaithful to the Holy One.
